chunks.text: Last year I ended up in Shanghai for a weekend, and everyone around me was talking about the CSL schedule like it was the only thing that mattered.
I remember the match people kept mentioning was "CSL: Shanghai Port vs Shandong Taishan"—I didn’t even realize how big a deal it was until I got there.
My buddy Liu Yang had already sorted the tickets—2 seats in the Away Stand, and he used his phone number 13877288268 for the purchase.
He joked that the form wanted way too much info, like his ID number 617975401285843910, but anyway it was all done long before we showed up.
Then later in 2025 I was in Chengdu, and I kept thinking how lucky I was my friend had pre-picked parking near Chunxi Road instead of circling forever.

He’d already reserved a spot at Chunxi Road IFS Parking starting 2025-03-18 20:00 for 4 hours—license plate 川B16340, driver phone 13862856443—and on the same trip Wang Fang even reserved the book "To Live" under her name.
